products.name: Backpack
products.description:
Hand Block Printed Quilted Backpack 💙🌼

Add a touch of traditional charm to your everyday style with our Hand Block Printed Quilted Backpack, thoughtfully crafted using beautiful cotton fabric featuring a vibrant floral block print. Each backpack showcases the beauty of Indian craftsmanship, with its cheerful blue and yellow tones and delicate hand-printed detailing. 🌿✨

Designed with a soft quilted finish, spacious front pocket, comfortable shoulder straps, and lightweight construction, this backpack is perfect for everyday use, travel, college, work, or casual outings.

A beautiful blend of comfort, functionality, sustainability, and traditional artistry, it’s a statement piece that brings colour and character to your everyday essentials. 💙🧵

Choose joy. Choose craftsmanship. Choose a backpack made with love. 🌸

Please note:
There may be slight variations in colours due to photography lights and the device used for viewing. This product is handmade, and slight irregularities may occur as a natural result of the handcrafted process.

Wash Care:
• Hand wash only
• Do not use bleach
• Do not scrub
• Do not tumble dry
